content: Hi there, I'm quite a beginner to Lean so sorry if I'm missing the point. I expect that Nat.Coprime is symmetric, so I expected the symm tactic would transform a.Coprime b to b.Coprime a, but it didn't. Is it because @[symm] is missing in the mathlib's definition? Does it make sense to create a small PR (or an issue) just to add it?
Try adding it locally and see if you can get it working. Your suggestion sounds good to me and a small PR would definitely be welcome.
